sqlMap.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM IF_GRDT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND LEGACY_PO_NO = #LEGACY_PO_NO# AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = #LEGACY_PO_SEQ# AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = #BUYER_ITEM_NO# AND LEGACY_GR_NO = #LEGACY_GR_NO# AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ = #LEGACY_GR_SEQ# AND LOAD_DATE||LOAD_TIME > #LOAD_DATE#||#LOAD_TIME#

SELECT
TO_CHAR(COUNT(*)) AS TOT_CNT, TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(GR_AMT),0)) AS TOT_AMT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(IF_FLAG,'E','X',NULL))) AS ERR_CNT, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DECODE(STATUS, 'D','D',NULL))) AS DEL_CNT FROM IF_GRDT WHERE BUYER = NVL(#BUYER#,' ') AND LEGACY_GR_NO = NVL(#LEGACY_GR_NO#,' ') AND REVISION = NVL(#REVISION#,' ')
